fields.before:
Description 
A lightweight frame bag for children. 
The Apidura + Bombtrack Frame Pack is a versatile piece of kit that could easily stay on your child’s bike full time, carrying bikepacking kit and toys or providing a convenient space to store trail finds.
The bombtrack frame bag is designed for children’s bike frame geometries and constructed from a lightweight, all-weather laminate that’s tough enough to avoid the tears and scuffs of off-road riding. It’s also suited for storing heavier items, lowering the bike’s centre of gravity and allowing for more natural handling.
Inside, the bag is divided into two compartments. The larger compartment has plenty of space for bulkier items such as clothing or a packed lunch. In contrast, the smaller pocket is useful for flat items such as journals. We’ve also installed a battery lead and hose port for charging electronic devices or drinking on the go.
While the body fabric of this bag is waterproof, due to the stitching process used to assemble the product, there is the possibility for water to enter through the seams when exposed to sustained rain. We recommend using an internal dry bag for contents that must remain absolutely dry. 
Technical 
Materials 
The bombtrack frame bag is made from Dimension-Polyant VX21, a four-layer laminated fabric originally developed for the maritime industry. Designed to fit the demands of off-road riding, the material combines waterproofing, light weight, low stretch, and high abrasion and tear resistance.
The velcro straps are reinforced with Hypalon, a durable rubberised nylon that provides extra protection against friction and puncture in areas of high stress. For the fastening system, Woojin buckles are used for their reliability.
Care 
Wash the bombtrack frame bag by hand, using a mild diluted soap if necessary. Afterwards, let it air dry.
Do not machine wash, machine dry, or iron.
Size info

description.ru: Подседельная сумка Apidura объёмом 5 L. Характеристики взяты с официальной страницы производителя.

after.manufacturerDetails:
Description 
The quintessential bikepacking bag, reimagined to perfectly complement the Canyon Grizl. 
The Apidura x Canyon Saddle Pack is ready-for-adventure and performance-oriented, drawing upon a complementary mix of Racing and Backcountry Series features. Much like the Grizl, the pack is designed to be lightweight and rugged enough to tackle anything from the hour-long spin before work to a 200-mile gravel race.
Constructed from an ultralight, waterproof laminate developed for Apidura and reinforced with an abrasion resistant panel, the seat bag is designed to fit ergonomically under the saddle, minimising sway and reducing drag. A roll-top closure provides adjustable capacity, and tailored webbing, straps and buckles shed extra weight, while ensuring the simplest setup for ease of use when every second matters.
Technical 
Precision Crafted using seam welding for unbeatable waterproofing. The saddle bag mixes Racing Series design features and construction techniques for a lightweight minimal design, alongside Backcountry Series features for enhanced durability.
Materials 
Hexalon to keep weight low and ensure the pack is waterproof
Hypalon reinforced straps and attachment points to enhance durability
420D nylon abrasion panel to protect against wear in the toughest conditions
Care 
Wash by hand, using a mild diluted soap if necessary. Afterwards, let it air dry. Do not machine wash, machine dry, or iron.
Size info

Hexalon Lightweight, waterproof & weldable trilaminate of TPU, Nylon & PU developed for Apidura. PFAs and PFC-free.
420D Embossed Nylon Durable, semi-rigid woven nylon with good abrasion, tear and puncture resistant properties.
Ultralight Minimal design & lightweight materials for optimal weight-performance.
Welded Waterproof RF welded seams & bespoke fabrics for a 100% waterproof and ultra durable construction.
Product Information 
Weight 
– 210g
Storage Configuration 
– Main compartment
– Internal mesh pocket
– Adjustable internal divider
Closure System 
– Waterproof two-way zipper
Attachment System 
– 3 Hypalon reinforced velcro straps attach to top tube
– 1 Hypalon reinforced velcro strap attaches to steerer
Reinforced Structure 
– HDPE integrated structure
Waterproofing 
– Seam Welded – bespoke materials and RF welding create watertight seams
Visibility 
– Reflective graphics
Size info 
Care & Maintenance 
Lubricate zippers Clean & lubricate zippers regularly with silicone or petroleum-based grease to maintain performance.
Spot clean only Stains can be spot treated with concentrated dishwashing liquid. Abrasion is not recommended

before.manufacturerDetails:
Description
An expandable bottom compartment accommodates more mission-critical gear.

Details
We carefully consider what is put in each of our bags and tailor the compartments, pockets and other features to make sure there is a perfect place for everything. Sometimes you need more space, while other times you need less. This bag expands to accommodate both. The coated 210 ripstop nylon and polyurethane zippers provide extra protection and water resistance. Includes an adjustable mounting system to fit most any bike.

Key Features
ORGANIZATION — We carefully consider what is put in each of our bags and tailor the compartments, pockets and other features to make sure there is a perfect place for everything.
EXPANDABLE — Sometimes you need more space, while other times you need less. This bag expands to accommodate both.
HOSE PORT — Outpost Elite frame bags feature a hose port to allow for the storage of a water reservoir and/or a cache battery to get dense, heavy products to the lowest center of gravity.
WATER RESISTANT — Coated 70d ripstop nylon and polyurethane zippers provide extra protection against the elements.
ADJUSTABLE MOUNTING — Bikes come in a lot of shapes and sizes. This bag includes adjustable mounting systems to allow fitment to almost any bike.
LIFETIME WARRANTY —

before.manufacturerDetails:
Description 
The FRAME BAG XT / 02 is the larger version of the otherwise identical FRAME BAG / 02 and offers even more space for larger frames. This frame bag also features two weatherproof zippers, a flat compartment for documents, money, and other essentials, as well as the spacious main compartment for larger items. Two internal mesh pockets provide additional organization for small items, and a key hook ensures that keys are always within easy reach. The front, covered (cable) opening is also present on this bag. The FRAME BAG XT / 02's 3.2-liter capacity can securely store a variety of gear that needs to be easily accessible while riding, such as tools, a power bank, a lock, or a jacket.
The FRAME BAG XT / 02 is ultralight, robust, and weatherproof thanks to our specially developed LiteGrid-RN200T3 material. We achieve this by combining two different thicknesses of nylon using a special weaving technique to create a ripstop fabric, which is then coated on both sides and high-frequency welded. This results in the perfect symbiosis of lightness and stability – for weatherproof products that are easy to clean.
Compatibility 
FRAME BAG XT / 02 setzt eine ausreichende Rahmengröße sowie genügend Freiraum unterhalb des Oberrohrs voraus, der bei manchen Mountainbikes durch die Dämpferanordnung nicht gegeben ist. Durch die Form der Tasche können Trinkflaschen im Flaschenhalter in der Regel verwendet werden. 
Material 
Recycled PA/N6.6 200D R/S TPU/PU3, Hypalon, POM, HD-PE, Elastic PA Mesh, Weatherproof zippers, Reflective film 
Technical Specifications 
Volume: 3.2 l
Size: 46 x 6 x 13 cm (L x W x H)
Weight: 150 g (without reinforcement), 216 g (complete) 
Scope of Delivery 
Bag
Alternative hook and loop fasteners
Frame protection film
Instruction booklet

before.manufacturerDetails:
Description 
The TOP TUBE BAG LARGE / 02 is the larger sibling of the TOP TUBE BAG / 03 and, with a volume of 2.2 liters, is the ideal solution for those who ride for extended periods, don't have room for a frame bag on their frame, or simply desire the convenience of more storage space with direct access while riding. The TOP TUBE BAG LARGE / 02 also features a very large opening to the front compartment, which is secured with a flap and Fidlock magnetic buckle. The rear compartment opens with a central, weatherproof zipper, making it perfect for storing items you don't need to access as frequently while riding. Its tapered shape prevents contact with your thighs. Features familiar from the smaller version, such as the cable port, are also present in the TOP TUBE BAG LARGE / 02. Despite its large volume, it's an ultralight bag that has already gained many fans, especially among ultra-distance riders. Compared to the previous version, the front strap design has been further developed: The hook and loop strap is now replaceable and extendable – making it compatible with integrated handlebars. In addition, the bag is now bolt-on ready and can be screwed onto the top tube.
The TOP TUBE BAG LARGE / 02 is ultra-lightweight, robust, and weatherproof thanks to our specially developed LiteGrid-RN200T3 material. We combine two different thicknesses of nylon using a special weaving technique to create a ripstop fabric, which is then coated on both sides and high-frequency welded. This results in the perfect combination of lightness and stability – for weatherproof products that are easy to clean.
Compatibility 
Die TOP TUBE BAG LARGE benötigt einen Mindestabstand Steuerkopf-Sattelstütze von 44 cm. Sie ist mit allen CYCLITE FRAME BAGs und den meisten Rahmentaschen anderer Hersteller kompatibel, da die Position der Fixierungsgurte verschoben werden kann. 
Material 
Recycled PA/N6.6 200D R/S TPU/PU3, Hypalon, Elastic PA Mesh HD-PE, EVA, Weatherproof zipper, magnetic buckle, Reflective film 
Technical Specifications 
Volume: 2.2 l
Size: 42 x 5 x 12 cm (L x W x H)
Weight: 204 g (without divider), 212 g (complete) 
Scope of Delivery 
Bag
Alternative hook and loop fasteners
2 screws M5 x 12 with O-rings
Frame protection film
Instruction booklet

description.en: Lightweight Race Hydration Vest (4 Litres) is a Restrap backpack in 4 L. Technical data is normalized from the official product page.
description.ru: Рюкзак Restrap объёмом 4 L. Характеристики нормализованы по официальной карточке товара.

before.manufacturerDetails:
When your only goal is to ride from A-B in the fastest time possible, your priorities are aerodynamics, comfort, weight and to be able to access fuel as ergonomically as possible. The Restrap Lightweight Hydration Vest is built without compromise. READ MORE
Stripped back weight, no compromise to function. Building on our award winning Race Hydration Vest, but reducing the overall capacity of the vest, we have improved its breathability, reduced its weight; but kept all the features that made the original so popular. 
Working with UCI gravel race winners, FKT setters and one-day specialists, what was initially an exercise in cutting back weight from the classic Race Hydration Vest became a ground-up redesign. 
Minimalist construction
The lightweight mesh construction features four stretch pockets on the front, an underarm stretch pocket on each side. That full stretch construction means complete freedom of movement while on the bike. Minimalist elastic chest retention can be adjusted and even unclipped with one hand; ready for fast changes at feedzones. 
The rear includes a hydration bladder sleeve (bladder included). Hose routing can be run over either shoulder, with a magnetic clip to hold the hose in place when not in use. And because even on the shortest races, conditions can change, there’s a stretch rear pocket for an emergency layer. We’ve included reflective detailing to increase visibility at night. 
Fitting
The Lightweight Race Hydration Vest comes in two sizes: 
S/M – chest sizes between 80 and 100cm – t-shirt size XS to M
L/XL – chest size between 100 and 12cm – t-shirt size M to XXL

Working with UCI gravel race winners, FKT setters and one-day specialists, what was initially an exercise in cutting back weight from the classic Race Hydration Vest became a ground-up redesign. 
Minimalist construction
The lightweight mesh construction features four stretch pockets on the front, an underarm stretch pocket on each side. That full stretch construction means complete freedom of movement while on the bike. Minimalist elastic chest retention can be adjusted and even unclipped with one hand; ready for fast changes at feedzones. 
The rear includes a hydration bladder sleeve (bladder included). Hose routing can be run over either shoulder, with a magnetic clip to hold the hose in place when not in use. And because even on the shortest races, conditions can change, there’s a stretch rear pocket for an emergency layer. We’ve included reflective detailing to increase visibility at night. 
Fitting
The Lightweight Race Hydration Vest comes in two sizes: 
S/M – chest sizes between 80 and 100cm – t-shirt size XS to M
L/XL – chest size between 100 and 12cm – t-shirt size M to XXL

before.manufacturerDetails:
Introducing our Race Hydration Vest, a comfortable and practical way to carry fluids and nutrition while riding long distances or out into the unknown. Made with a focus on functionality, the Race Hydration Vest is designed specifically around fuelling on the bike. The high placement on the back ensures maximum comfort in the riding position and compatibility with jersey pockets, allowing for easy access to essentials while on the move. It has been developed to adopt a genuine unisex design, ensuring comfort for individuals across all genders and body types. READ MORE 
The Race Hydration Vest prioritizes comfort with three points of adjustment – sides, shoulders, and chest. The chest retention system offers five points of adjustment, featuring stretch webbing, an integrated whistle for safety, and an easy on and off clip system that is glove-friendly. Equipped with a 2L bladder, the pack features an expandable internal lining for superior bladder fitment, eliminating any discomfort during extended rides. The back of the pack has two stretch mesh drop pockets that will easily hold two extra bottles and webbing loops that can be used for carabiner attachment for other items, such as race trackers. The front of the pack features easy-to-reach stretch mesh pockets ideal for carrying a water bottle and snacks. Also featured is an expandable zip pocket with a key clip inside, for quick access to valuables. The ambidextrous bladder routing system and adjustable magnetic keeper clip allows users to choose exactly where they want to route the drinking tube and store it when not in use. The inclusion of reflective zip pulls, logos, and webbing detailing enhances visibility from all angles, aiding safety during low-light conditions. A light loop also allows attachment of a clip-on light. Available in two sizes: Small/Medium & Large/XL Weight - (without bladder) Small/Medium - 368g Large/XL - 380g Bladder weight 146g Capacity - 5.5L with 2L Bladder Capacity (7.5L total)

before.manufacturerDetails:
There are times when it’s more comfortable or practical to carry larger loads on your back. Capitalising on the huge success of our original Race Hydration Vest, the Rolltop Hydration Vest takes the same comfortable structure, accessible front storage pockets and 2L hydration bladder that won us a Design and Innovation Award in 2024, then combines it with a larger capacity, fully waterproof rear.READ MORE
Super stable – even when filled to its 14L capacity – the Rolltop Hydration Vest is perfect for the most adventurous bikepacking trips. It is also the ideal companion for big days out in the mountains where being safe means packing the layers, tools and spares for complete self-sufficiency. 
Fit 
In addition to being available in two sizes (S/M and L/XL), the Rolltop Hydration Vest prioritizes comfort with three points of adjustment – sides, shoulders, and chest. This allows flexibility for fitting over layers and changing loads over the course of a long ride. Your load will stay stable, no matter how rough the terrain you are covering.
The Race Hydration Vest is a gender neutral design and has been developed with (and tested by) all genders with a range of body shapes.
Carry what you want – where you want 
The Vest features stretch pockets on both the front and rear. Store snacks, a multitool or even a soft bottle at the front of the pack, up to a 500ml bottle on the sides and the larger rear stretch pocket is perfect for a waterproof jacket on those days where the weather can’t make up its mind - saving you the effort of opening the rolltop, also keeping the rest of the contents dry. The main compartment is fully lined and 100% waterproof, thanks to its rolltop closure.
The front also features an expandable zip pocket with a key clip inside, for quick access to valuables like a phone.
A water bladder drops into an expandable lining and the shoulder straps feature ambidextrous hose routing. A magnetic keeper clip keeps the hose and bite valve out of the way (but still to hand) when not in use. 
The inclusion of reflective zip pulls, logos, and webbing detailing enhances visibility from all angles, aiding safety during low-light conditions. A light loop also allows attachment of a clip-on light.
Available in two sizes: Small/Medium & Large/XL
Weight - (without bladder)
Small/Medium - 588g
Large/XL - 600g
Bladder weight 146g
Capacity - 14L with 2L Bladder Capacity

before.manufacturerDetails:
Designed for adventure, convenient for the commute, our Restrap Switch Pannier is the perfect partner for those who like to carry more, or simply prefer a pannier system to bikepacking bags. They are also ideal for smaller bikes with less clearance for saddle and bar bags. Simply attach to your fork bosses or any compatible rack. READ MORE
The Restrap Switch Pannier combines durable, waterproof external fabrics to create an extremely hardwearing, easy to clean outer. Paired with a fully seam-sealed inner, you can be confident that the contents will stay dry; whether it’s your sleeping bag or work shirt. 
Included: 10 Litre Pannier Bag and Switch Multi-Mount bracket
Click and go
The Restrap Switch Pannier uses an injection moulded clip that drops directly into the Hiplok x Restrap Switch mount and a flexible back plate that provides structure to the pannier, while also dampening vibration and minimising rattles over rough ground.
The Hiplok x Restrap Switch system is a quick, simple and secure, modular fitment that can be used anywhere that has bottle bosses. It is ideal for many modern gravel forks and compatible rear racks. The Hiplok x Restrap Switch system not only allows you to place and remove your panniers in a matter of seconds, it also allows you to switch between panniers and the Hiplok Switch Lock. You can also quickly switch between carry and bottle cages with the Switch Multimount. Flip between load lugging, quick commuting and extra hydration from one day to the next. 
Fitting 
Hiplok x Restrap Switch system can be fitted to any bottle bosses. 
Please use the bolts provided. We recommend tightening the bolts to 5Nm, but please check your fork manufacturer’s specification. 
We recommend not exceeding 3kg weight including the bag itself. This is because most bottle boss mounts are only rated to 1.5kg per bolt.
To attach the Switch Pannier, simply slide the Switch clip into the Switch mount bracket.
To remove the Switch Pannier, press the base of the Switch clip towards the bag and gently lift upwards. 
Packing and use 
It is easiest to fill the bag before attaching it to the bike
Ensure three folds on the roll-top closure to guarantee full waterproofness
Product Weight - 520g (including fitting)
Capacity - 10 Litres

before.manufacturerDetails: Introducing the Utility Hip Pack, a meticulously designed piece of kit tailored to enhance your bikepacking expeditions. This bag is both a hip pack and a bar bag, with considered design in both areas there is no compromise in either function. READ MORE With an ergonomic fitting that accommodates a wide range of body types, the Utility Hip Pack ensures a comfortable and secure fit during long rides. Its adjustable retention system allows for a personalised fit, keeping the bag snugly positioned against your lower back, minimising movement and maximising stability. Versatility is at the core of the Utility Hip Pack's design. The bag's waist straps ingeniously fold into the back panel, seamlessly transforming it into a practical bar bag with a fast strap retention system, letting you switch between hip and bar configurations on-the-go. Also included is a headtube retention system. The Utility Hip Pack boasts a roll top closure featuring a fully waterproof and tape-sealed internal compartment, shielding your belongings from the harshest weather conditions. The addition of an easy Fidlock magnetic closure ensures quick and hassle-free access while maintaining a secure seal. Also included is reflective detailing to enhance visibility during low-light conditions, and stretch mesh side pockets which offer quick and effortless access to smaller essentials. Whether you need to reach for energy bars or store a water bottle, these pockets provide easy organization and accessibility. Finished with our classic vegan friendly PU Restrap label. Weight - 361g Capacity - 6L

before.manufacturerDetails:
**Update: This bag is taking a break and we are not making it at this time. As a small, made-in-USA manufacturer it’s sometimes challenging to offer such a diverse product range. At the moment, we are rebuilding our workshop from a flood and are focusing our efforts on our core expertise; custom framebag and waterproof bag options. It’s unlikely this offering will come back anytime soon, but you can still sign up for the in-stock alert. Thank you for your understanding.
Stable, accessible storage with electronic cord access. Comes with 1/4″ Dog Bone Spacer but please note the  Spacelink  is sold separately.
Features that make this bag great 
Electronic cord access ( e.g ., headphones, dynamo cords)
1-handed opening/closing when riding
Dog-bone foam spacer at stem
Glow-in-the-dark zipper pull
Rubberized bottom webbing to prevent rotating off the top tube
Connect to our Spacelink for enhanced stability and clean aesthetics
All Ultra PE fabrics (aka dyneema, EPL, Cuben Fiber) are +$10 to the base price. These fabrics have especially high strength to weight ratio.

Dog-bone foam spacer at stem
Glow-in-the-dark zipper pull
Connect to our Spacelink for enhanced stability and clean aesthetics
All Ultra PE fabrics (aka dyneema, EPL, Cuben Fiber) are +$10 to the base price. These fabrics have especially high strength to weight ratio.

AXS compatible (wireless dropper post)
Lightweight and stable to excel on singletrack

before.manufacturerDetails:
Microwave Panniers are a from-scratch rethinking of the traditional micro panniers. Modular, ultra-secure, truly waterproof, and super light, they are equally suited to riding rough trails as they are to urban living.
The two-part system includes a quick-access drybag and a rugged holster that secures to any rack. The stiff, black HDPE back plate uses Voilé Straps® for upper mounting that can’t move in any direction. Five options for lower mounting keeps these totally rattle-free.

The MTX TrunkBag uses a unique material process to provide our largest, stiffest, and most weather resistant MTX series bag. In addition to the expandable top section and rear water bottle holder, the side panels expand to full panniers maximizing capacity. Compatible with all MTX QuickTrack® racks with attachable side frames. MTX Dual Side Frames are required when using panniers on MTX BeamRacks.

CAPACITY
19.4 L

COMPARTMENTS
1 divided main with multi-stage expandable top
Two side with expandable panniers

MATERIAL
600 denier polyester

MAX LOAD
Limited to rack maximum load rating

INSULATION
Molded EVA foam

BAG ATTACHMENT
MTX QuickTrack® with attached side panels

ADDED FEATURES
Water bottle holder, Shoulder strap
Carrying handle, 3M™ reflective strip
Safety light clip, Elastic top bungees
Optional rain cover
* 3M™ is a registered trademark of 3M Company.

SIZE
36 x 25 x 21.5-29 cm / 14.1” x 9.8” x 8.5”-11.4”

WEIGHT
1140 g / 2.51 lb

Built to go further! The E-Xplorer TrunkBag is an eBike specific spare battery carrier made of rigid EVA foam and Polyethylene providing structure, excellent impact absorption, and water repellency. In addition to the expandable top section, the side panels expand to full panniers maximizing capacity. The grip straps secure a spare battery in place while 3M™ reflective strips and attachable rear light MOLLEcompatible strap add extra safety. Compatible with Topeak’s MTX QuickTrack® 2.0 racks, there’s even enough room to carry additional gear for your eMTB adventures!

COMPARTMENT
One compartment

CAPACITY
26 L / 1590 ci 
Battery dimension within 42 x 10 x 11 cm / 16.5” x 3.9” x 4.3”

INSULATION
Rigid EVA foam

Polyethylene / Engineering grade polymer

BOX ATTACHMENT
MTX QuickTrack® 2.0 system with attached side panels and 3 additional hook and loop fasteners / Compatible with TetraRack M2L

MAX LOAD
Limited to rack max load rating

SIZE
43.4 x 29.4 x 23.7 cm / 17.1” x 11.6” x 9.3”

WEIGHT
1217 g / 2.68 lb
